gauge.name: Tongue River near Dayton

impacts.statement: Major flooding in Ranchester. Low land flooding in Dayton intensifies and becomes more widespread. Flood wave travel time from Dayton to Ranchester is 6 to 7 hours.
Low land flooding in Ranchester intensifies and becomes more widespread. Minor low land flooding in Dayton.
Minor low land flooding begins downstream in Ranchester. Flood wave travel time from Dayton to Ranchester is 6 to 8 hours.
Bankfull near gauge. The right bank begins to overflow.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey

hydronotes.statement: Stage may be affected by ice during winter months.
River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Graphical forecasts are not available during times of high water, forecast crest information can be found in the local WFO web page.
